upward from the file being analysed, so a config here scopes correctly -
unlike VS Code's python.analysis.extraPaths, which is Pylance-only and can
point at just one project at a time.
Symptom this fixes: 'Import "dotenv" could not be resolved' on packages
that are demonstrably installed, because the checker was resolving against
the repo-root .venv instead of this project's myenv.
venvPath is relative to this file. No Python version appears anywhere here,
so rebuilding myenv on a different Python does not silently break it.
